name: David Perfect

tenures.role: wrestler: AWF World Heavyweight Champion for the first time in October 2005
tenures.note: The front page of 23 October 2005: "David Perfect defeated 2 strong men Crisis and one being the Champion of the World Genocide to become the AWF World Champion for the first time"; it bills "The World Heavy Weight Champion David Perfect" for the Glory house show of 31 October 2005.

caption: AWF World Heavyweight Champion for the first time after beating Crisis and Genocide, the champion, named the fed's superstar of the week on its front page of October 2005 and billed for the Glory house show of 31 October.

name: Crisis

tenures.role: wrestler: beaten by David Perfect for the World title in October 2005; a three-time AWF World Heavyweight Champion, retired, by May 2008
tenures.note: The ladder of May 2008: "Crisis 12 - 3 - Retired from action a 3 time AWF World Heavy Weight Champion and multiple other type of champion." The page of October 2005 names ":Crisis from Hell:" its character video of the week.

caption: A three-time AWF World Heavyweight Champion with a record of 12 wins and 3 losses, listed as retired on the fed's ladder of May 2008; his character video was the fed's pick of the week in October 2005.
